# TechInterviewPrep

> Free IT interview practice platform with 1200+ hand-crafted questions across 40 technologies including Oracle, AWS, Java, Python, Linux, Docker, React, Kafka, Vault, and more.

## Pages

- /: Home — browse 40 IT courses and start practicing
- /about: About TechInterviewPrep — features, badge system, and course list
- /leaderboard: Global leaderboard of top scorers by course and difficulty
- /race: Real-time challenge mode — race head-to-head against another player
